# tlsinfo

> TLS connection analysis: CLI + Go library. Reports handshake state, certificate chains, key pins, OCSP status, crypto hygiene. Zero-bloat: stdlib + paepcke.de/certinfo + paepcke.de/reportstyle + golang.org/x/crypto only.

Repo: https://github.com/paepckehh/tlsinfo | Docs: https://pkg.go.dev/paepcke.de/tlsinfo

## Commands

- `make test` — offline unit tests (loopback-only TLS server, no network)
- `make check` — gofmt -w -s, go vet, go fix, golangci-lint (root + cmd/)
- `make examples` — run CLI against live hosts (network)
- `go run paepcke.de/tlsinfo/cmd/tlsinfo@latest <host>` — run the CLI

## Layout

- `api.go` — public library API + generic backend (the core)
- `generic.go` — unexported helpers (consts, version table, splitAddr, addPort, dial timeout)
- `starttls.go` — STARTTLS backend: protocol table (`_starttlsProtocols`), upgrade dialer
- `cmd/tlsinfo/` — CLI main (thin wrapper, env-vars-only config)

## API quick map

- `ReportHost` / `ReportStartTLS` — full report for a host (implicit TLS / STARTTLS)
- `PinHost` / `PinVerifyHost` — SPKI base64 key pins, trust-on-first-use
- `ReportTlsState` / `ReportConn` — report from `tls.ConnectionState` / `*tls.Conn`
- `ReportHttpRequest` — server-side variant: report your own HTTPS clients
- `ReportOcsp` — stapled OCSP status (needs the issuer certificate)

## Conventions

- CLI config via env vars only: `NO_COLOR`, `VERBOSE`, `HTML`, `PINONLY`, `STARTTLS` (empty value = off)
- Errors embedded in returned strings: `[tlsinfo]` / `[starttls]` `[error] ...`
- STARTTLS protocols: `smtp`, `imap`, `pop3`, `nntp`, `ftp`
- go 1.27, CGO disabled, gofmt -s; `v*` tag pushes cut goreleaser releases

## For agents

See AGENTS.md for repo commands, architecture, conventions and gotchas before changing code.
